How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CUSB CRS Project Fellow (Junior) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUSB CRS Project Fellow (Junior) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in Physics with a minimum of 55% marks. For Level II, additional qualifications like JEST/GATE/NET-JRF are required.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior) position?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹14,000 pm (Level I) to ₹31,000 pm (Level II), plus HRA at 10%.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CUSB CRS Project Fellow (Junior) post?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Central University of South Bihar located?
faq.answer: The Central University of South Bihar is located in Gaya, Bihar.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for this position.

faq.question: Q10. What documents do I need to attach with my application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
